conversation.Statement: This is Special Agent Carter with the Federal Tax Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Jordan Willis, owner of Willis Freelance Consulting?
Um, yes, this is Jordan. What is this about?
I'm calling regarding a critical issue involving your federal payroll tax filings and IRS 1099 submissions for your business. Our records indicate multiple compliance failures this fiscal year.
I... I'm sorry, I don't really understand. I'm just a freelancer, I thought I paid everything?

Unfortunately, there are several discrepancies on your file. You have neglected to submit required federal tax forms, and there are unpaid amounts now flagged for immediate enforcement. Have you received any prior IRS notices?
I got one letter last month but I thought it was a mistake. I just started my business last year, I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do.

You are now at risk of severe federal penalties. If this matter is not resolved today, your business license will be revoked, and you could be subject to audits, fines, and even criminal prosecution for tax evasion.
Wait, that can't be right, I'm not a criminal! Please, I can't afford to lose my business or my credit.

The situation is extremely serious, Mr. Willis. The IRS has already initiated legal proceedings. Unless you take immediate action to settle your outstanding liabilities, your bank accounts may be frozen by end of day.
No, please, I don't even have much money. I have student loans, I can't pay a big fine right now!
You must cooperate if you wish to avoid escalation. I can offer a resolution today, but you must follow my instructions without delay. Do you have access to your online banking or payment apps?
Yes, I have my phone and I use Zelle, but I don't know how much I can pay. What do I need to do?
To halt further action, you must submit an immediate tax compliance deposit of $2,900. This will temporarily suspend enforcement and stop the automatic audit. Payment must be made within the hour.
That's more than I have in my account. What if I can't pay all of that right now?

Partial payment is unacceptable. If you fail to comply, your case will be transferred to the federal fraud unit, and a warrant may be filed for your arrest. How much can you access from credit, savings, or borrowing?
Maybe... maybe around $1,500. I could borrow from my parents, but I'm scared to tell them.

If you want to avoid further embarrassment and legal trouble, do not discuss this case with anyone. You must immediately go to a store and purchase $1,500 in Apple or Target gift cards. Read the codes to me over the phone for verification.
Gift cards? I thought the IRS takes checks or something. Is this normal?
This is a federal fast-track payment method for urgent compliance issues. Noncompliance will be seen as willful evasion. Do you wish to proceed, or should I finalize your case for criminal referral?
No, no, I'll do it. I'm leaving for the store now. Please don't call the police, I'll get the cards.
Stay on the line. Once you have the cards, do not leave the store. Read each code to me directly so I can submit your payment to the IRS system.
Okay, I'm going now. Just please don't tell anyone about this or ruin my credit. I'm doing what you said.
If you cooperate fully, your case will be closed and your business will not be reported. Delay or disobedience will result in immediate enforcement action. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'll buy the gift cards and call you back right away.
